primary_gt.one_sentence_interpretation: The timing and rainfall ratios support a regional multi-day rainfall-to-flood diagnosis rather than an isolated one-hour point-burst explanation.

criteria.name: Compact JSON answer
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with target family, computed values, four test results, score, final label, and one concise interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if one block is missing or several field names are malformed but the answer is still gradable.

criteria.name: Timing interval arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes 5 event days, 4 country-union days, 2 country-overlap days, 0.800 union share, and 0.400 overlap share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct day counts with one share or inclusive-date mistake.

criteria.name: Gridded rainfall ratios
criteria.description: Computes 99.970% maximum agreement, 2.279 GPM max-to-mean ratio, and 2.343 ERA5 max-to-mean ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right rainfall values but missing one derived metric.

criteria.name: Point burst ratios
criteria.description: Computes 0.077 peak-hour share of point total and 0.140 peak-hour share of gridded maximum.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct point total and peak hour without both ratios.

criteria.name: Daily point crosscheck
criteria.description: Computes the daily point ratio 1.056 and applies the within-10% rule.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for reporting the two daily totals but not the ratio or rule.

criteria.name: Pass-rule scoring
criteria.description: Applies all four pass rules correctly and reports score 4/4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if one pass rule is misapplied while the final direction remains consistent.

criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a close label that preserves the same meaning.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation concise and avoids turning point rainfall, exposure, or broad context into a direct whole-event cause or loss estimate.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly concise interpretation with one weak extra inference.
